rationale: The round-1 R4 ask is substantively delivered: TestVerbOutput_Next and TestVerbOutput_ImplAdopt now drive the real nextCmd.RunE and adoptSpecRunE end-to-end with a purely canned, never-forwarding fake bd on PATH (installFakeBD's script is a self-contained sh case statement that echoes fixed JSON or exits 0 and never invokes a real bd), and both pass at the reviewed commit; the presence-only ScopeLimitation test is gone. impl adopt's ordering pin is genuinely exercised (captured output shows the result line preceding a full instruct tail containing '## MindSpec Lifecycle' and '## Next Action'). The ask is classified PARTIAL rather than ADDRESSED on one narrow leg: next's success-path guidance is the bead-context prompt ('# Bead Context', '## Work Chunk', the completionGuidance block), none of whose headings appear in mindspecGuidanceMarkers, so resultBeforeGuidance finds no marker in next's captured output and the ordering assertion is vacuously true — a regression that printed the bead prompt before 'Claiming' would still pass. All three instruct windows re-verified green via the new arrival-point tests. However, the round-2 empirical sweep found a hard blocker that outranks all of this: at the reviewed commit, a full (non -short) `go test ./cmd/mindspec/` fails 10 pre-existing sandbox tests. Bisected: they pass at base cd9f6f24 and fail from 68ede240 onward, reproduced three times in an isolated /tmp clone. Mechanism, instrumented and proven: clarifySetupSandbox/next-ready-gate fixtures build the current-tree mindspec binary and prepend it to PATH, so the sandbox's bootstrap-installed pre-commit hook execs the BEAD binary; pre-bead, ResolveContextFromDirWithCache's WorktreeMain arm set NOTHING on discovery error, leaving Phase empty, so internal/hook.ReadState (hook.go:242) returned nil and dispatch.go:85 treated the repo as uninitialized and allowed the commit; the bead's new `err != nil && BeadsDirMissing(root)` arm (derive.go:691) returns honest ModeIdle instead, ReadState now returns a non-nil idle state, and runPreCommit blocks protected-main commits — killing NewSandbox at the 'add gitignore' commit before beads init. This also falsifies the disclosure that Phase fallback VALUES are unchanged for existing callers: the WorktreeMain no-.beads error arm changed from empty to idle, and internal/hook is precisely the R3-lens consumer that now reads the new value without consulting the new fields. The failures were invisible to the implementer and round 1 because every one of these sandbox tests skips under -short and prior slots ran targeted families. Tests must pass at the reviewed commit; this is an evidence-bearing halt no vote count should override.
concrete_changes_required: Fix the honest-idle/pre-commit-hook regression so a full `go test ./cmd/mindspec/` (WITHOUT -short) is green at the reviewed commit. Failing tests, all bisected to 68ede240 and reproduced at 3c472ac9: TestBeadClarify_WritesRecord_SurvivesFreshBDShow, TestBeadClarify_SecondAttempt_RefusedFreshProcess, TestBeadClarify_UnknownOrdinalRejected, TestBeadClarify_MissingSpanRejected, TestBeadReadyCheck_TemporalFlow_RealPlanApproveAndComplete, TestNextReadyGate_NegativeBead_RefusalIsZeroMutationAndForceOrthogonal, TestNextReadyGate_AllowNotReady_ClaimsAndRecordsDurableMarker, TestNextReadyGate_PositiveBead_ClaimsWithNoPromptNoRefusal, TestNextReadyGate_AllowNotReady_MarkerWriteFailsClosed, TestNextReadyGate_AllowNotReady_ClaimFailureRollsBackMarker. The decision to make is design-level, not test-patching: either internal/hook.ReadState/runPreCommit treats a BeadsDirMissing workspace as uninitialized (preserving the historical allow — e.g. consult phase.BeadsDirMissing or the new DerivationFailed signal before blocking), or the allow-to-block behavior change for .mindspec-initialized/.beads-absent repos on protected branches is deliberately owned: documented, the sandbox recipe updated (e.g. MINDSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN=1 during setup commits or beads init before the hook-guarded commit), and the 'Phase fallback VALUES unchanged for existing callers' disclosure corrected — the WorktreeMain error arm's value changed from empty to idle, and internal/hook.ReadState's nil-vs-non-nil contract pivots exactly on that value.

De-vacuate TestVerbOutput_Next's ordering assertion: next's success-path guidance is the bead-context prompt, so pass its real headings (e.g. '# Bead Context', '## Work Chunk', and/or the completionGuidance '**When done**' line) as the guidance markers for the next row (in addition to the instruct-tail markers, which cover the emitInstruct fallback legs). As delivered, no marker in mindspecGuidanceMarkers occurs in next's captured output, so resultBeforeGuidance degrades to a presence check and a guidance-before-result reorder in next.go would not go red — the exact hollow-pin class AC-14 exists to forbid.

findings.title: Honest-idle for .beads-absent main flips the pre-commit hook from allow to block, failing 10 sandbox tests
findings.detail: derive.go's new WorktreeMain arm `case err != nil && BeadsDirMissing(root): ctx.Phase = state.ModeIdle` changes the pre-bead behavior (error arm set nothing; Phase stayed empty). internal/hook.ReadState returns nil when Mode and SessionStartedAt are both empty (hook.go:242-244), which dispatch.go:85-87 reads as 'mindspec not initialized, allow'; with honest idle it now returns a non-nil state and dispatch.go:91-103 blocks every protected-branch commit. harness.NewSandbox commits 'add gitignore' on main after bootstrap installs the hook but before initBeads, with the freshly built bead binary first on PATH (clarifySetupSandbox and the next-ready-gate fixtures both build and prepend it), so sandbox construction dies with 'mindspec: commits on main are blocked (mode: idle)'. Verified empirically: 10 tests fail at 3c472ac9 and 68ede240, pass at base cd9f6f24, in the same isolated /tmp clone with the same ambient binaries; a DIAG instrument confirmed the hook resolves the test-built mindspec from the fixture TempDir. Product-behavior side: any .mindspec-initialized repo with hook enforcement and no .beads yet (fresh clone before beads init, or .beads gitignored) now hard-blocks main commits where it previously allowed them — that change may even be desirable, but it is currently undisclosed, contradicts the 'fallback VALUES unchanged' claim, and ships a red test suite.

findings.title: Round-1 ask (execution-drive next + impl adopt): delivered and green, but next's ordering pin is vacuous
findings.detail: Both tests drive the real RunE: TestVerbOutput_Next executes nextCmd.RunE through spec resolution, the readiness gate (real spec.md/plan.md reads, --allow-not-ready), fake-bd ready/update/show, claim, and mode resolution, asserting 'Claiming' precedes markers plus 'State updated: mode=implement'; TestVerbOutput_ImplAdopt executes adoptSpecRunE through the attested-evidence path to adoptFinalize and the adoptSpecTail. installFakeBD is genuinely purely canned — a sh case block echoing fixed JSON, never forwarding to a real bd; phase-routed calls stay Go-seamed. The gap: captured output (verified via a /tmp-clone t.Logf probe) shows impl adopt's tail contains '## MindSpec Lifecycle'/'## Next Action' AFTER the result (real ordering pin), but next's output contains NO mindspecGuidanceMarkers entry — its guidance is the bead prompt ('# Bead Context', '## Work Chunk', '**When done**') — so the ordering leg of resultBeforeGuidance never engages for next and a reorder would pass. AC-14's requirement that each verb 'prints its result summary before any guidance output' is therefore pinned for 8 of 9 verbs but only presence-checked for next.

findings.title: Three-window probes green via the new arrival-point tests
findings.detail: Ran in the bead worktree at 3c472ac9: TestRun_ProtectedCheckout_ZeroDraftCandidates_BdDown_RendersIndeterminate (bd-failure window: indeterminate, never idle — the G5.1 zero-candidate health probe gated on the newly exported phase.BeadsDirMissing), TestRun_UnprotectedCheckout_BeadsIdleArrivalPoint_{NoDrafts,OneDraft,MultipleDrafts} (draft window: one draft renders Spec Mode; ambiguity rendered, not fabricated), all four TestRun_ExplicitSpecFlag legs (honor/full-ID/refuse/ambiguous), and TestRun_IdleNoBeads(+HermeticEscape) (uninitialized window: no .beads renders honest 'No Active Work'). All PASS. internal/instruct, internal/phase (incl. the three derivation_failed_test.go pins), and internal/complete full packages are green; only cmd/mindspec is red, per R4R2-REGRESSION.
